reason: In src/sentry/search/events/datasets/discover.py:1041-1052, SnQLFunction("upsampled_count", ...) omits private=True (defaulting to private=False in src/sentry/search/events/fields.py:1310), so BaseQueryBuilder.resolve_function (src/sentry/search/events/builder/base.py:737-738) allows any caller to invoke upsampled_count() without an ACL. Because DiscoverDatasetConfig is loaded for Discover, Transactions, Events, and IssuePlatform (src/sentry/search/events/builder/discover.py:65-71), users can bypass the allowlist and error-query checks in src/sentry/api/helpers/error_upsampling.py:101-118 and emit sum(sample_weight) on datasets that lack sample_weight.
